ceiling_directive: Prove that a named published causal-panel model contains this Gaussian four-block experiment and extend the profile interval’s honesty and rank-two achievability bound to that published class.
improvement_directive: Prove finite-grid-to-continuum convergence and use the limiting dual to determine the sharp simultaneous oracle excess, or show that the profile interval attains it, on the same rank-and-strength union.
critique: The note proves constant-order rank-zero and rank-one frontiers and a matched constant-factor rank-two rate only for its frozen four-by-four Gaussian exact-rank union. It does not determine the exact simultaneous excess, and the exact finite-grid programs are not proved to converge to the continuum problem; the sixty-four-orientation result establishes only a local constant gap, not an additional adaptation-rate gap. The framing accurately discloses these limitations, so there is no stale claim of an exact sharp constant, but calling the result a broader causal-panel frontier would exceed the proved custom experiment. The nonrandomized attainment claims also rely on an unproved purification lemma whose bibliography entry is merely a placeholder rather than a precise classical citation. Without a transfer theorem to a published panel class or a sharp continuum characterization, the contribution remains a narrow companion result rather than a field-level econometric result.
